claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Trichostatin A at 2.5 uM kills cells primarily through HDAC inhibition, a cytotoxic class effect shared with other hydroxamic acid HDAC inhibitors, with possible contribution from cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress at higher concentrations.
